keyFindings.description: Two texts outside the shipped tool contract still state the ad-hoc delivery rule without the serve-port caveat the tool description and the docs-site row now carry. Neither is false: skills/envoy/SKILL.md:143-145 states the rule 55 lines above and a skill is read whole, and architecture.md is a developer's endpoint table rather than an agent's tool description. The architect ruled on 2026-10-22 that both stay, on the pull request's Fast-follow line, rather than cost a fourth implement/test/review round. Raised by thermonuclear-deep-review at this head as Low; recorded, not requested.

The doc comment above publishHandler still describes only the agent-topic refusal and not the notifications. prefix refusal the handler now enforces at api.go:597-600 — the security-relevant one. api.go is one of the four hunks held byte-identical with dispatch://INFRA-117, so a comment edit here would diverge them before dispatch://INFRA-120 merges the branch. Fast-follow, to land where that freeze lifts.

The parenthetical glosses bus.usesCoreTransport as taking 'every topic ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS does not capture', dropping the notifications. half of the predicate. The bullet's own subject is an ad-hoc notifications. topic and the publish row at AGENTS.md:1899 states it correctly, so it misleads nobody in place. Fast-follow.

risksRecordedNotFixed.description: With the new listener live before the hub's widened grant is rendered, every ad-hoc publish is denied, and internal/bus/confirm.go:71-76 attributes a connection's last error to any core publish in flight, so a role-lane forward sharing that connection can fail with it. It self-heals (the forward is NAKed and redelivered, cmd/listener/delivery.go:218-230) and the window is bounded by the hub roll, but it is a cost the spec's 'if one must go first, the image goes first' ruling does not name. Raised by thermonuclear-deep-review at this head; sent to the architect, not a defect of this diff, which deploys nothing.

risksRecordedNotFixed.item: A wildcard topic is accepted rather than refused
risksRecordedNotFixed.description: Carried from round one and ruled recorded-not-filed by the architect: notifications.> and notifications.*.probe answer 200 and publish as literal subjects, reaching only a wildcard subscriber, no agent subject and no stream subject.
cmd/listener/delivery.go:150-155 is reachable but behaviour-neutral after this change. Tracked as dispatch://INFRA-124.

rounds.finding: The shipped envoy_publish description (packages/envoy-client/src/tool-contract.ts:187, the regenerated claude-envoy bundle) and the docs-site row (docs/site/src/content/docs/dispatch/envoy.md:123) claimed an ad-hoc topic reaches every subscribed session 'yours included', which is false and silent for a session the listener delivers to over a serve port.
rounds.resolution: Fixed in 6788db65: both texts now scope the claim to a session holding its own NATS connection and name the serve-port case and dispatch://INFRA-122; the bundle was regenerated with bun run build and check-dist is green in CI's claude-envoy job. Verified against cmd/listener/main.go:733, cmd/listener/durable.go:123, internal/session/session.go:62 and the tester's push-delivered probe, where the stream-captured control was pushed and the ad-hoc topic produced no push, no exception subject and no delivery line.
